content: Selecting OBD 3 Byte DTCs with extended data records If Dem_SetDTCFilterByExtendedDataRecordNumber is called with DTCFormat 189 of 536 Document ID 19: AUTOSAR_SWS_DiagnosticEventManager Specification of Diagnostic Event Manager AUTOSAR CP R21-11 equal to DEM_DTC_FORMAT_OBD_3BYTE and DemSupportedObdUdsDtcSepara- tion is set to True, the Dem shall use the DTCs configured via DemDtcValue3Byte as filter target.
